final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.death_state AS st, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(c.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_above_overall_avg FROM c, a WHERE c.cnt > a.avg_cnt
